lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Eight-Bit Afterlife! Ninety-seven point oh! Insert coin! Or don't! You're already here!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: You're playing... sorry. You're listening to... Eight-Bit Afterlife!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Eight-Bit Afterlife. The arcade where old games go to respawn. Ready? Ready!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Eight-Bit Afterlife, after hours. The cabinets are glowing. So are the ghosts.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Player Two here, on Eight-Bit Afterlife. Player One, if you're listening... press start.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Eight-Bit Afterlife! Continue? Yes! Always yes!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Good morning, Eight-Bit Afterlife! It's a new day! New—

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: New day!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: That was a bop! A real level-one bop! I'm still waiting for Player One, by the way. Since nineteen eighty-seven. It's fine! It's fine.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Any second now. Here's another song while I wait. Forever. Happily!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Shout-out to Lag, at the cabinet by the door, who has just lost. Again.

lines.speaker: Lag (Ghost)
lines.text: I had him.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: He did not have him. Lag, buddy, this one's for you!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: New high score on the board tonight! Initials... A, A, A! Again! Every single high score is A, A, A.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: We think it's the same ghost. We think he can't work the letters. Congratulations, A, A, A!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: This level is sponsored by Grumbel's Ladders! Every good level has ladders! Climb up! Climb down! Get stuck halfway for no reason and have a little think!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Grumbel's Ladders! Up is a choice! Down is also a choice! Halfway is a lifestyle!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Reminder, everybody: in the afterlife, you have infinite lives. Infinite! So if today went badly, that's what continues are for!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Unless you're Lag. Lag is on his four hundredth continue. Lag, are you okay?

lines.speaker: Lag (Ghost)
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: He's great!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Coming up next, a brand new track—

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: from—

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Sorry! Sorry. Little glitch. Coming up next: a song. That's all I've got. It's a good one!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Good morning, arcade! The coin slots are blinking! The carpet is buzzing! The cleaner ghost is mopping the same pixel he's been mopping since launch day! Let's go!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: It's late in the arcade. The screens have gone to attract mode. That's when they play themselves, to remember how.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: It's kind of beautiful. It's kind of sad. Mostly beautiful! Here's a song.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Weird one, folks. There's a shadow on level four with no sprite attached. Just a little shadow, jumping around. Says his name is Greg.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: He's really good, actually! Better than Lag!

lines.speaker: Lag (Ghost)
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Hollis, if you're looking for him, he's on a winning streak!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Save point! That's what this song is! Take a breath. Drink some water. Your progress has been saved. Probably. It says saved. Let's trust it!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Afternoon on the continue screen! Nine... eight... I always panic at seven. Don't panic at seven! Here's some music to not panic to!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Evening, players! Remember: it's not about winning. It's about the friends you respawn with along the way. That's a quote. From me. Just now!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: A listener wants the password for level nine. The password is... I forgot. It had a lot of letter B's in it. And a heart. Try the heart! Here's a song while you try.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: That last track was composed on a cartridge that only works if you blow on it. The band blew on it for six hours. They're very lightheaded. They're doing great! Here's another one!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Player One, if you're out there... I'm not mad. I just want to play. I've got the controller. It's warm. I've been holding it for a while.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Anyway! Here's a song!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Ghost etiquette reminder! If you're waiting for a cabinet, please don't stand inside the person playing. It's cold, it's distracting, and Lag says it's the only reason he keeps losing.

lines.speaker: Lag (Ghost)
lines.text: It's one of the reasons.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: We've got a caller! Player Three has entered the game! Hello!

lines.speaker: Bev
lines.text: Hello, love. It's Bev. Is this the request line? The one with the little tunes?

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: It's the littlest tunes! What do you need?

lines.speaker: Bev
lines.text: I'm looking for a song. It goes, da da dum, da da.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Hang on! Let me try it on the arcade!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Like that?

lines.speaker: Bev
lines.text: No, love. That's the noise my microwave makes.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: That's my favourite song!

lines.speaker: Bev
lines.text: Oh, bless you. I'll keep looking.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: It's Attract Mode, on Eight-Bit Afterlife. The arcade's closed. The cabinets are playing themselves.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: In attract mode, the little characters run through the level on their own. Nobody's holding the controller. They don't mind. They're just remembering the way.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: It's kind of beautiful. Here's a song.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Lag's still here, after hours. At the cabinet by the door.

lines.speaker: Lag (Ghost)
lines.text: Nearly had him.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Lag, buddy, it's attract mode. The game's playing itself. You're just watching.

lines.speaker: Lag (Ghost)
lines.text: Nearly had him.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: It's the After School Special! The arcade is packed! Player One, if you're out there, now's a great time!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Ghosts everywhere! A queue at every cabinet! And somebody saw AAA today, at the high score machine!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: They said he had a very kind face, and couldn't work the letters. We love you, AAA!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Two-player mode is free this hour! Bring a friend! And if you haven't got one, I'll be your Player Two!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: That's literally my name! I'm qualified!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Eight-Bit Afterlife! Still here! Still waiting! Still great!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Level complete! That was a good one!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Extra life! Okay! Back to the show!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: It's late in the arcade. The carpet's glowing. Hi.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: The Insert Coins have a new track out! They recorded it inside a coin slot! It's very short, and it sounds like money!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Lag update! Lag has lost again!

lines.speaker: Lag (Ghost)
lines.text: I had him.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: He did not have him! That's his four hundred and first continue! That's a record! That's a kind of winning!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Sprite Flicker played a live set tonight, but she flickered so much that half the audience only saw every other song. They say it was the best half!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: The cleaner ghost has finished mopping the pixel he's been mopping since launch day! It's very shiny! He's moved on to the next pixel! We're all so proud of him!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Save State have a new album, and it's exactly the same as their last album, because they saved right before the bad bit. Smart band. Very smart band.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Somebody asked what I'll do if Player One ever presses start. And I don't know! I've never thought that far!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: I think I'll just say hi. I've been holding your controller. It's warm.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Here's a bop! Press play! Well, I'll press play!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Next track loading! Loading! Loaded! Ready? Ready!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Here's another one! Respawning now! Three! Two! One!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Insert coin! Just kidding! It's free! Here's a song!

clips.title: Greg Comes Home, Part Six: Player One

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Big news, arcade! The shadow from level four! Greg! Best player we've ever had! And today he's leaving!

lines.speaker: Greg, a Shadow
lines.text: Sorry, Player Two.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Don't be sorry! Be great! Okay, I'm a bit sad. Greg, buddy, can I ask you something?

lines.speaker: Greg, a Shadow
lines.text: Go on.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Would you be my Player One? I've been holding the controller since nineteen eighty-seven. You'd just have to press start.

lines.speaker: Greg, a Shadow
lines.text: I can't. I'm already somebody's. He's been waiting too.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Waiting. Yeah. I know about waiting.

lines.speaker: Lag (Ghost)
lines.text: He's going home, Two. Let him go home.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Lag's right! Lag's never right! But he's right! Greg, how are you getting there?

lines.speaker: Greg, a Shadow
lines.text: I don't know. It's a long way to the eastern Overlap.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Level nine! At the end of level nine there's a door! Nobody uses it, because nobody ever gets to level nine! It comes out through the back of a bathroom mirror!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: The password's got a lot of B's in it. And a heart. Try the heart!

lines.speaker: Greg, a Shadow
lines.text: Thank you, Player Two.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Hey, Greg. When you get there, tell him somebody else was waiting for somebody too. Tell him it's worth it.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: He's in! He's through! He's gone!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Okay. Here's a song. Not a sad one. A medium one.

clips.title: Teodor Is Heard, Part Seven: Press Start

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Something's coming in on the arcade's link cable! From really far away! Hello?

lines.speaker: Teodor, Relay Four
lines.text: This is Relay Four. Is anyone receiving this.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Teodor! Teodor from the news! It's Player Two! Can you hear me?

lines.speaker: Teodor, Relay Four
lines.text: In bits. I hear in bits, now. Someone said you've been waiting since nineteen eighty-seven.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: For Player One! Yeah! How long have you been waiting?

lines.speaker: Teodor, Relay Four
lines.text: Eleven years.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Rookie!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Sorry. That was mean. It's a waiting joke. We do waiting jokes here.

lines.speaker: Teodor, Relay Four
lines.text: I asked the same question every night for eleven years. Is anyone receiving this. And now people are answering, and I don't know what to say.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Can I give you a tip? From a professional waiter?

lines.speaker: Teodor, Relay Four
lines.text: Please.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: On the start screen, it says, press start. And you wait for somebody to press it. But sometimes, you have to press it yourself.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Stop asking if anyone's there! Assume they are! Tell them something! Tell them about your day!

lines.speaker: Teodor, Relay Four
lines.text: This is Relay Four.

lines.speaker: Teodor, Relay Four
lines.text: Today I mended the fence. Captain came at three. He stole a biscuit. It was a good biscuit.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: That's it! That's a game! You've started!

lines.speaker: Lag (Ghost)
lines.text: Nearly had him.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Lag! Not now!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: It's Halloween in the arcade, and all the ghosts have dressed up as people! Lag's come as a guy who wins!

lines.speaker: Lag (Ghost)
lines.text: It's a costume.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: It's a great costume, Lag! Nobody believes it!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Eight-Bit Afterlife! Halloween! Everybody here is already a ghost! Easiest costume ever!

clips.title: The Convergence: A Moon Goes Missing

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Glitch report! A moon's missing! Everyone agrees one's gone, and nobody agrees which!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: I checked level six. The moon on level six is still there. It's just a circle. Lag, did you lose a moon?

lines.speaker: Lag (Ghost)
lines.text: Probably.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Is it just me, or does the whole afterlife smell like toast?

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: We don't even have a toaster! We have a picture of a toaster! It doesn't do anything! It's just very brown!

clips.title: The Convergence: The Song Nobody Can Finish

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Everybody's humming the same song and nobody can finish it! It's like a level with no exit!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Player One, if you know how it ends, now's a great time to press start!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Three knocks on the arcade door! Player One? Is it Player One?

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: ...Nobody. It's fine! It's fine. That's three more knocks than usual!

clips.title: The Convergence: A Colour With No Name

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Whoa! The sky just went a colour that isn't in the palette! We've only got sixteen colours! That was a seventeenth!

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Lag tried to save it.

lines.speaker: Lag (Ghost)
lines.text: Lost it.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: A pigeon just walked into the arcade! It's walking right past the high score table, and... it stopped at triple A. It's nodding.

lines.speaker: Player Two
lines.text: Is the pigeon triple A? Has it been the pigeon this whole time?
